contradictions_found: Contradiction with 00 §6.4 (decided value of FR-FLOW-009 AC-5, shared by SEC-FLOW-012 AC-6). 00.overview.md:556 row 'R34 × 새 기기 admin': '사용자 단독 키로 429. 기존 기기에서 로그인하거나 다른 관리자가 lockout 해제. 남는 위험으로 문서화' (another admin's lockout release is a stated way out of the user-only-key 429). FR-FLOW-009 AC-5: 'The release clears only the Lockout state and leaves every login throttle key as it was (decided 2026-11-02; SEC-FLOW-012 AC-6)', and SEC-FLOW-012 AC-6: 'the same new-device login right after another admin's DELETE /auth/admin/users/:id/lockout still gets 429 from the user-only key'. 00 R34 (4) ties DELETE …/lockout to the hard lock only, so 00 is internally ambiguous; the decision picks R34 (4) and voids the §6.4 remedy. Needs an owner ruling: either DELETE also resets that user's user-only throttle key, or 00 §6.4 is amended.
